title: Report shortest dependency paths from graph_brief
rubric: The CLI exposes a paths subcommand with --graph, --direction, --max-hops, --max-paths, and --json while preserving brief/demo behaviour.
Endpoint lookup prefers exact stringified ids over exact labels and reports deterministic not-found and ambiguity errors with status 2.
Path search honours forward, reverse, and both edge directions and ignores malformed or unknown-endpoint links.
Shortest-path computation respects max_hops, handles cycles without repeated nodes, and treats identical endpoints as one zero-hop path.
All shortest paths are collected, sorted lexicographically by full node-id tuple, and only then truncated by --max-paths with the exact text notice.
Text output matches the specified success, no-path, lookup-error, and truncation formats exactly.
JSON output uses sorted indented payloads with the exact specified keys and counts for success and errors.
New tests cover directionality, hop limits, cycles, tie ordering, JSON, lookup edge cases, malformed edges, and unchanged legacy graph_brief behaviour without adding subprocess/home/network access.
